propositions: The citation section in docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md does not explicitly state that the edge requirement must be DIRECT, leading to confusion when transitive dependencies are attempted.
The verifier det_citation._edge_verified correctly checks only direct edges (no recursive closure) and rejects transitive/indirect dependencies, but the documentation does not match this behavior.
A transitive or indirect dependency does not satisfy the citation edge requirement and should not be accepted as valid for citation.
The fix is documentation-only; the verifier code is correct and requires no behavior change.
The citation section must be updated to explicitly state the edge must be DIRECT and clarify that transitive/indirect dependencies do not count.
